facts.fact: 兄妹告别：Asmund 的「I always knew you were trouble, Vina」+举高高拥抱；与 Eirene 的同时「I love you」+小笑——「banishment be damned」的忠诚保证；Eirene 怀孕消息（「this baby will need their aunt」）；cottage 赠 Luminara（「Leave it all for her」）
facts.anchor: “I love you,” we say at the same time, and we both give a small giggle.

facts.fact: 出门即碎：撕下 Draven 的森林画塞进 bodice（「the memory of Estrold will not dim now」）；门永久关上+Eirene 的哀嚎——她用全部意志不去回头；对 Kosner/Einar 的最后一令「Watch over her. That's an order.」
facts.anchor: The door permanently shuts me out, and Eirene’s wail breaks me.

facts.fact: Seeker 描绘+命定相遇：黑焦橡木、四桅战舰、船首=一对蓄势的蛇——「when was the Seeker last in Drighton?」——四年前！ch01 的夜里她乘 skiff 路过的巨舰就是 Seeker、船头望着的身影就是 Draven；「I should have stopped you. I knew it was odd.」/「If you had…other lives would be different…I was theirs.」

Lumi 的托孤：Stablemaster Alphard 骑马追队——「You love her…and there is nobody I trust more than you to save her from this realm」；母亲久病（「Her mother won't…」未说完）；「I'll do it. I'll take her with me. It is the easiest decision of my life.」；Draven 把 Vision Stone 送 Alphard（「For her mother's care. Sell it.」）

启程对话：Alden 押车、Lumi 告别（「composure beyond her years」）；Stallion 的名字（「He does. Stallion.」她要赐名）；他纠正「Our ship」；「Snakes have made me everything I am」+「I wanted your love first—I never said I didn't think marks mattered」；书全留给 Alden（「in gratitude for bringing us together」）
facts.anchor: “Snakes have made me everything I am.”

facts.fact: 收束：Lumi 骑在 Jaco 上被她抱在怀里——「Her little heart beats so heavily that I can feel it through her back, against my chest, and through my armor.」——「Everything will be well, sweet Lumi.」
